blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Access to safe drinking water and clean sanitation facilities is just as critical to a child’s nutrition and classroom performance as serving nutritious meals, the Department of Education (DepEd) emphasized during a global education and nutrition summit in Lusaka, Zambia. At the Global Child Nutrition Forum 2026 held from Nov. 2 to 5, DepEd, represented by Assistant Secretary for Governance and Operations Roger Masapol, shared the Philippines’ experience in institutionalizing its Water, Sanitation and Hygiene in Schools (WinS) Program. DepEd showcased how sustained policy commitment, institutionalization, clear standards, and systematic monitoring have transformed school health environments nationwide. READ: DepEd […]...
